title: Bouncy ball short: intraday, shrinking bounces, squeeze guard
claim: After a crash each bounce is weaker, like a ball losing energy. Short the failed bounce with a stop just above it. That beats chasing the crash.

caveats: The pass is on DAILY Hyperliquid bars (123 alts), not intraday. Every intraday market (Binance 15m, 1h, 4h, Hyperliquid 15m) failed out of sample.

95 of 123 daily coins had no local funding file, so those trades carry no funding. On the 28 coins with funding, funding added only +0.03% a trade (about 0.00% out of sample), so the gap is small but real.
On the 28 coins with funding the same knobs made +0.76% a trade out of sample (255 trades, t 0.68): weaker than the full set.

Years are lumpy: 2022 +5.1%, 2023 -1.8%, 2024 -0.5%, 2025 +5.1%, 2026 +1.0%. The edge lives in alt bear years. Chase the crash on the same set also turned positive in 70% of daily combos out of sample, so part of the win is the alt bleed regime. The ball beats chase by 2.2% a trade on the same knobs out of sample, that part is the setup itself.
On daily bars the 30 bar and 30 day windows are the same thing, so each daily combo appears twice in the grid.
Equity curves are an equal weight portfolio, each symbol gets 1/n of capital, trades marked at the exit day. Sharpe and drawdown are on that curve.
